newsitem.title: USA: Worldtex says Euro sales seem to rebound.
newsitem.headline: Worldtex says Euro sales seem to rebound.

text.p: Worldtex Inc said its North and South American operations were showing strong growth at the beginning of the second quarter. "As we enter the second quarter, Worldtex's North and South American operations are showing strong growth, and sales at our European operations appear to be rebounding," said Barry Setzer, president and chief executive.
Worldtex said Thursday that in line with its March estimate, earnings for the quarter ended March 31, 1997 were $2.7 million compared with $2.7 million in the same period in 1996.

However, primarily because of an increase in the Company's shares outstanding in the first quarter of 1997 over first quarter 1996, earnings per share in the first quarter of 1997 were $0.18 cents compared to $0.19 cents in the comparable quarter of 1996. Sales for the first quarter of 1997 were $50.9 million, compared with sales of $51.9 million in the first quarter of 1996.
